source.author: ov
source.text: tum quoque priscorum virgo simulacra virorum mittere roboreo scirpea ponte solet.
source.text_original: tum quoque priscorum virgo simulacra virorum / mittere roboreo scirpea ponte solet.
source.text_english: Then too the maiden is accustomed to send the likenesses of ancient men on a wicker bridge of oak.

reuse.author: lact
reuse.text: haec sacra Vestales uirgines faciunt, ut ait idem: tum quoque priscorum uirgo simulacra uirorum mittere roboreo scirpea ponte solet .
reuse.text_original: haec sacra Vestales uirgines faciunt, ut ait idem: tum quoque priscorum uirgo simulacra uirorum mittere roboreo scirpea ponte solet .
reuse.text_english: The Vestal virgins perform these rites, as the same author says: then too the maiden is accustomed to send the images of the men of old across the bridge made of oak and wicker.
